title: Query route handler for trace, impact and coverage (TAC-4136)
description: handleQueryRoute(req, res, deps, url, route) is the shared handler for GET /trace.json, /impact.json and /coverage.json. Returns 503 before the first walk (AC-208-7), 404 QueryRouteError for an unknown id (AC-208-4), 400 for a bad-direction or bad-scope (AC-208-4), 200 application/json with cache-control: no-store on success (AC-208-1, -2, -3). The handler never imports runWithAdmissibilityGate and never writes under rcf/ (AC-208-5). Serves memoised entries from deps.queryCache keyed by state.version + route + pivot + direction|scope (AC-208-6). Co-sited with createRouter in src/server/routes.js.
